about: What is new in each update, shown to learners in the 'Update ready' popup and in Settings → Help → App updates. Newest first. Each update: a unique id, the date, a short title (up to 48 characters) and 1–3 plain points (up to 120 characters each). Add one whenever you push something learners will notice.

updates.title: Fixes to questions you reported
points: Typed answers now accept "It is …" and "The answer is …", names in brackets and either of two alternatives.
Clearer wording for some cardiovascular and organology questions, and two corrected chemistry answer keys.
Picture questions are no longer put into matching rounds, where the picture could not be shown.

updates.title: Cardiovascular Physiology: 23 new sections
points: New sections on action potentials, measuring flow and output, fetal circulation, arrhythmias and more.
Every lesson gains questions on its new material, with textbook pages and notes.
If you were partway through a lesson, it starts again from the beginning.

updates.title: Lesson quizzes stick to their lesson
points: A lesson's quiz and practice now ask only about that lesson, never about other lessons.
Every lesson now shows which lecture slides it was built from, before you open it.

updates.title: Organology past questions
points: Past questions on organ walls and coats now sit under Organology: practise them from the topic's card in Custom quiz.
They are also under Organology in the past question bank (By topic), and Organology has its own topic picture.

updates.title: Chats: the message box is back on screen
points: On a computer with the app zoom at 80% or 90%, the box for typing a message sat below the screen.
It now always shows at the bottom of the chat.

updates.title: New in Anatomy: Organology
points: Organology is now the first Gross Anatomy topic, before the Cardiovascular System.
Every picture from the lecture gets its own page: the organ, how many coats it has, and why.
Practise naming organs and counting their coats from the lecture pictures.

updates.title: “Explain it more simply” works again
points: On many laptops the explanation panel closed as soon as it opened.
It now stays open and explains the step from the basics.

updates.title: You choose when to update
points: The app no longer restarts by itself when there is a new version.
You will see what is new, then tap Update now when it suits you, or Later.

updates.title: Streak flame, shortcuts and confetti
points: Your streak now shows as a moving flame next to your day count.
On the installed app, press and hold its icon to jump to your streak, your reviews or the Daily 10.
A little confetti when you finish a quiz.

updates.title: Real dissection photos in Anatomy
points: Gross Anatomy lessons now include real dissection photos, blurred until you tap them.
Some photos are labelled: explore the parts, label them yourself, or answer quiz questions on them.

updates.title: Safer posts and blocking
points: Friends-only posts can now be opened only by your friends.
Blocking someone stops them following you, commenting or seeing your stories. Undo it in Settings → Privacy.

updates.title: Free Radicals updated
points: The HB2 Biochemistry topic Free Radicals and Oxygen Toxicity now follows the 2026 lecture slides.

updates.title: Apex Explained videos
points: Explore has a new Apex Explained section with short videos, and lessons link to their videos.

updates.title: Easier HB1 lessons
points: Abbreviations such as MCV are spelled out the first time they appear.
Formulas show real fractions, and tables use the full width on laptops.
A lesson's practice now asks every question its button promises.
